label: Google Docs
agentGuide: Base path /v1. Read: GET /documents/<id> (body.content[]: paragraphs with elements[].textRun.content; headings in paragraphStyle.namedStyleType; tables); the id is the one in the document's URL. Create: POST /documents {"title": "..."} (empty; then write). Write: POST /documents/<id>:batchUpdate {"requests": [{"insertText": {"location": {"index": 1}, "text": "..."}}]} — index 1 is the start of the body; to append, use endOfSegmentLocation: {} instead of location. Formatting: {"updateParagraphStyle": {"range": {"startIndex": 1, "endIndex": 20}, "paragraphStyle": {"namedStyleType": "HEADING_1"}, "fields": "namedStyleType"}}, bold: updateTextStyle with textStyle.bold and fields "bold". Replace: {"replaceAllText": {"containsText": {"text": "{{name}}", "matchCase": true}, "replaceText": "..."}}. Indexes shift after every insertion: compute them from a fresh read, or write from the end backwards. Finding documents is Google Drive's job.
